title: reforged-ts rename map
description: Every public symbol a major version removed or renamed, with its replacement. The migration guide and the legacy-names lint rule are generated from it. A version pair whose major renames nothing carries a no-renames marker instead, so the release gate sees the pair was considered.

symbol.description: A class, or a class-qualified static or instance member, as an author writes it; `(...)` marks a call.

oldSymbol.description: A symbol, a symbol after `new`, or an entry point of `addScriptHook` (`main::before`).

packageName.description: An npm package name, as an import names it: `w3ts`, `reforged-ts`.

version.description: A package and its major version.

versions.description: The major versions the entry applies between.

noRenames.description: The no-renames marker: the major of the version pair removes and renames no public symbol. It stands in for the entries of the pair, so the major-changeset gate and the migration page see the pair was considered; the lint rule ignores it. A pair has entries or the marker, not both.

note.description: What the major changes instead, in one sentence.

old.description: The symbol as an author of the `from` version wrote it: `new Unit(...)`, `Group.getEnumUnit`, `Frame.parent`, `hookedMain`; an entry point of `addScriptHook` as its `W3TS_HOOK` value reads, `main::before`; or, for kind `package`, the package name an import names, `w3ts`.

new.description: The replacement as the author will write it; several when the old symbol splits (a get/set pair, overloads mapped by argument shape); null when there is none. For kind `package`, the new package name.

kind.description: What the old symbol is. An `entryPoint` is one of the four entry points of `addScriptHook` (`main::before`, `main::after`, `config::before`, `config::after`); its replacement, when there is one, is the Init stage at the same moment or the closest later one. A `package` is the package itself, renamed: its `old` and `new` are package names, and an import from the old name reads the new one.

oneToOne.description: Whether the rewrite is mechanical: replacing the old symbol with the new one keeps the arguments. The lint rule autofixes only these.

note.description: Why the symbol changed, in one sentence.
